purpose: Measure QH native-score and coil-engineering distributions for the visually accepted balanced stellarator prior.

construction: visibly noncircular low-order stellarator-symmetric reference axis
winding surface with field-period variation in size, elongation, orientation, triangularity, and helical ripple
stratified contour levels fitted to order-16 Cartesian Fourier curves
generator.sample_variation: Per-sample axis harmonics, surface phases, balanced shape amplitudes within +/-15%, and contour phase.
generator.inner_surface_role: geometric_reference_only; not evaluated in native scoring

sample_design.conditions: 26 balanced (nfp,nc) conditions: nc=1 with nfp=4..8; nc=2..4 with nfp=2..8
sample_design.duration_basis: Invalidated v1 produced 953 rows over six GPUs in approximately 9 minutes, with representative shard throughput 3.43 seconds per sample.
sample_design.expected_wall_time: approximately 1 hour; completion is count-bounded rather than wall-time-truncated

primary_outputs: coil length, curvature, intercoil distance, axis distance, high-mode energy, and current diagnostics
condition-stratified statistics and representative coil HTML views

default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
